hooks.name: GxP guards after edits in src/ or docs/
hooks.description: Runs the read-only static guards (< 2 s) after each agent file write. --hook reads the event JSON on stdin and skips writes outside src/, docs/, data/ and .kiro/. PostToolUse with the built-in 'write' tool category runs in Kiro IDE, CLI V3 and Web (Web has no file triggers).
